I had my Maltipoo groomed by KY, and the experience was fantastic. He was gentle, patient, and made my dog feel completely comfortable throughout the process. The grooming itself turned out great—my pup looks adorable and well cared for. Highly recommend!

Extremely Disappointed — Groomer Injured My Cat and Denied Responsibility

I recently rescued a severely matted Persian cat and began calling around to find a groomer with experience handling extreme cases. When I spoke with Ky, I was very clear about her condition and he assured me he could help. I was initially grateful he could get me in the next morning.

Unfortunately, the experience was deeply upsetting. Ky was scheduled to arrive at 6:30 AM, but showed up closer to 7:00 without communicating any delay beyond a vague “I’m on my way” text. Despite her severe matting, he claimed to be finished just 15 minutes after starting. He rushed me over the phone, saying he had to leave immediately, even though I had let him know in advance I would be gone for about 20 minutes dropping off my daughter. I paid remotely and returned to find my cat in alarming condition. I had assumed the service would take at least an hour, so thought I had plenty of time to run up the road, as he had also said this was fine.

She had been poorly shaved, still smelled, had mats remaining on her feet — and most disturbing, was missing a nipple. When I confronted Ky about this injury, he denied causing it and instead accused me of neglect and abuse, despite me having explained several times that I had just rescued the cat the day before.

After attempting to raise my concerns, I was blocked, and Ky began deleting parts of our conversation (he accused me of neglecting the cat) and will now claim I acted erratic and that’s why he blocked me. I’ve documented everything — the cat’s condition before and after, proof of her recent rescue, and screenshots of our communications.

This experience has been traumatic for both me and my cat. Not only was the grooming substandard, but she was physically harmed, and I was treated with hostility and dishonesty. I’ve initiated a refund process with my bank for services not rendered. I urge anyone considering using this groomer to proceed with caution.
Ky was very quick, communicative and able to wrangle a relatively skittish cat!
forward to seeing you again😊 …

I recently had my pup groomed by KY and they did a great job—my dog looked great and seemed comfortable afterward, which is the most important part. It’s clear that they take care in their work and knows their craft well.

One area that could make the experience even better is communication. A quick introduction upon arrival and a simple “How would you like your dog groomed today?” would go a long way in making the process feel smoother. Also, if he prefers owners to hand off their dogs a certain way—like using a leash instead of carrying them—it would be helpful to mention that upfront. These small adjustments could enhance the customer experience while keeping things running efficiently.

That being said, he clearly has strong grooming skills, and I appreciate the care he put into my pup. With a little more communication, I think he could provide an even better experience for pet owners while continuing to do great work with the animals. For those who prefer a more communicative approach, this is something to keep in mind—but overall, I’d trust him again with my dog’s grooming needs!

KY definitely know how to work with pets. He came in an introduced himself to professionally even to my dog! I was nervous at first cause my dogs never been groomed by anyone but us. The Out come was outstanding.

UPDATE!!! Ky is a scam!!! He charged me 221 for his mistake! I really liked him so I booked again. This time he made up lies and didn’t follow directions very well. DO NOT TRUST HIM!! He just charges your card with no service provided

Kyle was about 10 minutes late.

Kyle. I am not satisfied with your washing, cleaning, and brushing job. My dog is still wet and not fully dry. My dog has a double coat, and I don't want her to have an issue with being wet on her undercoat or smell.

Also, your pricing is not transparent. You quoted me $160 after I told you that my dog previously needed a muzzle. I also explained that she has a double coat and needed a de-sheding. I told you her breed, weight, and everything ahead of time. Including her temperament.

I got a link that then said $127 to $147 as an estimate.

Then you changed it and charged me $182, including a handling fee and a de-sheding fee.

Next time, to another customer, I think it would be wise to explain the "potential" costs. It was very bait and switch behavior.
Ky did an awesome job with our three dogs. Don’t hesitate to call him, your animals will love you for it.

Tells me he knows how to handle dogs.  She's a little hyper,  but he knew just how to handle her.  He did a great job with her. She looks great! We will definitely use Ky again.

Received a text on day of appointment approximately 30 minutes before that my appointment was canceled due to being "Outside our service area". I live in central Phoenix adjacent to the Biltmore. To add insult to injury, they stated "I would not be charged for the call". What a way NOT  to run a business.
